releases.name: Project Brain v1 and Platform Intelligence Registry
releases.summary: Added a runtime Project Brain service, visible subsystem versions, stronger diagnostics, event waiting contracts and generic decision rule evaluation.

releases.name: Platform Doctor Version Contract Hotfix
releases.summary: Made the Platform Doctor version display manifest-driven and aligned Project Brain subsystem metadata with the active platform manifest.

releases.name: Decision Audit and Event Contracts
releases.summary: Added durable decision explanations, event contracts, audit history and permanent regression tests for release identity.

releases.name: Subsystem Registry Consistency Hotfix
releases.summary: Introduced a central Subsystem Registry as the sole source of truth for subsystem names and versions, with permanent consistency checks.
